aging_floor_safety_note: The aging floor is a clinical safety constraint, not a tuning knob, so the grid only contains values that keep ESI 1-2 protected. 2.5 (the configured value) lets an aged low-acuity patient overtake a fresher ESI 3 or 4 but never a freshly arrived ESI 1 or 2; 3.0 stops ESI 3 ageing at all. 2.0 is NOT tested: it lets aged patients overtake ESI 2, whose mean wait then triples (9.4 -> 31 min). Measuring an unsafe policy to three decimal places does not make it available.
